purpose: FR-50 (protocol fr50-one-way-records-v1): code-blind absolute one-way fluxes and their records, per route, at declared states: kinds' passive routes and an ATP-driven transporter (phase 1), and @3's membrane route, junction, uncharged face and a blocked channel population (phase 2). Declared values and protocol only: no engine value is in this file.

K1_neutral_zero_net.route: neutral passive route on a patch (LAWS.md section 2), forward inward
K1_neutral_zero_net.requested: forward and backward fluxes, and the records F(t_i), B(t_i)

K2_neutral_relaxation.route: neutral passive route on a patch, forward inward

K3_charged_kernel.route: constant-field route of a charged species of valence +1 on a patch, forward inward; a host evaluation at declared voltages, no trajectory
K3_charged_kernel.requested: forward and backward fluxes at each voltage, and their ratio

K4_transporter_equilibrium.route: the ATP-driven transporter of LAWS.md section 3 at equilibrium, forward = forward cycles
K4_transporter_equilibrium.requested: dG_cyc/(R T) (it should be 0: report it), J+ and J-, and the records F(t_i), B(t_i)

K4h_transporter_off_equilibrium.route: the same transporter, at a state off equilibrium; a host evaluation, no trajectory
K4h_transporter_off_equilibrium.requested: dG_cyc/(R T), J+, J- and J-/J+

E1_membrane_route_at_reversal.route: @3's membrane route of K (a patch's own permeability), forward outward, at V = E_K
E1_membrane_route_at_reversal.V: E_K = (R T / F) ln(c_out / c_in), to 50 digits
E1_membrane_route_at_reversal.requested: E_K, the forward and backward fluxes (equal), and the records F(t_i), B(t_i)

E2_junction_neutral.route: a junction route of a neutral species between two cells, forward sender to receiver, at equal concentrations and equal potentials

E3_face_uncharged.route: an uncharged face between two finite outside nodes, forward sender to receiver, at equal concentrations

E4_blocked_channel_at_reversal.route: a gate-free K channel population (kleak_always_open@1) with FR-51's block, forward outward, at V = E_K
E4_blocked_channel_at_reversal.requested: E_K, u (it should be 1/2: report it), the forward and backward fluxes, and the records

E6_blocked_channel_off_reversal.route: the same population at declared voltages off reversal; a host evaluation, no trajectory
E6_blocked_channel_off_reversal.requested: u, the forward and backward fluxes, their ratio and their difference at each voltage and each availability (the availability multiplies both directions, as o and u do)

format: one JSON file per case, results/<case id>.json, every number as a decimal string of at least 20 significant digits, plus method and provenance
